name: NTAMS180-X1
aliases: 新一代180吨全自动封装系统

evidence.excerpt: 在研项目情况 单位:万元 项目名称 新一代180吨全自动封装系统开发NTAMS180-X1 预计总投资规模 450 本期投入金额 23.04 累计投入金额 407.11 进展或阶段性成果 项目结题 拟达到目标 满足用于SOP、SOT、LQFP、SMA、QFN、DFN等产采用transfer molding封装形式的产品封装

notes: Next-generation 180-ton fully automatic transfer-molding system. The mechanism is not inferred: the FY2025 report's own 拟达到目标 column names 'transfer molding' in Latin script. Carried at molding_transfer on that basis. The project was already marked 项目结题 in the FY2024 report, and the two vintages cross-foot -- FY2024 cumulative 384.07 plus FY2025 period 23.04 equals FY2025 cumulative 407.11 -- which confirms row, column and year alignment across two separate filings. No customer and no memory or HBM application is claimed for this platform in any Naike, Sanjia or Zhonghe filing read for this packet. The stage word reflects the issuer's declaration that the development project closed, not an independently corroborated production volume; treat it as a company claim. W13 RECORDS REVIEW (correct) by claude_w13_records_verifier: Name/row 'NTAMS180-X1' confirmed via pdftotext -layout on naike_annual_2024 physical p30, row 6, paired with budget 450/period 384.07/cumulative 384.07/status 项目结题 -- and cross-footed against the FY2025 table (naike_annual_2025 p31, non-layout: budget 450/period 23.04/cumulative 407.11), where 384.07+23.04=407.11 confirms row-and-year alignment across two filings exactly as the record claims. category_id molding_transfer is correctly supported by the issuer's own 拟达到目标 cell naming 'transfer molding' in Latin script. HOWEVER reported_maturity 'mass_production' overstates the issuer's actual status word: 项目结题 means an R&D project was formally CONCLUDED/closed out, which is an administrative R&D-table milestone, not a volume-production claim -- none of 成功开发/客户验证/小批量/实现量产/产业化 is used anywhere for this platform, and the record's own notes concede 'not an independently corroborated production volume... treat it as a company claim' without going on to fix the field itself. Tellingly, the record's own maturity_history entries correctly label both the FY2024 and FY2025 citations as '项目结题 (project concluded)' -- only the top-level summary field upgrades this to 'mass_production', an internal inconsistency within the record. No customer, shipment or revenue figure is cited anywhere in the packet for this specific model. Corrected to a value that names the issuer's actual status word, following the atlas's existing 'rd_project_table_项目进展_X' naming convention (seen elsewhere, e.g. rd_project_table_项目进展_验证阶段).

name: NTCMS40-V1

evidence.excerpt: 压缩成型封装设备NTCMS40-V1 该设备及技术运用在半导体先进封装工序，采用粉末树脂对基板尺寸规格小于等于100mm×300mm进行压缩封装成型，用于如WB-BGA精细线路以及FC-BGA倒装芯片球栅格阵列封装基板、以及Chiplet设计模式以及人工智能带动高性能计算芯片的封装需求。该设备正在厂内测试中。

notes: Strip/substrate-level compression molder, <=100mm x 300mm, aimed at WB-BGA, FC-BGA and chiplet/AI-accelerator packaging (no memory or HBM application named). FY2025: 'currently undergoing in-house/factory testing' (该设备正在厂内测试中) -- company's own prototype-stage wording, closest to the atlas's 'lab' stage word (研发中/样机研制) since testing is still in-house, not yet with a customer. H1 2026: 'has been shipped to a customer for trial use' (已发往客户端进行试用) -- matches the atlas's 'trial' stage word (发往客户验证中/shipped for customer validation) exactly. Both stages are company claims with no independent corroboration found. No memory or HBM customer or application is named anywhere. W13 RECORDS REVIEW (accept) by claude_w13_records_verifier: Name/excerpt '压缩成型封装设备NTCMS40-V1...该设备正在厂内测试中' confirmed via pdftotext -layout on naike_annual_2025 physical p29, row 27 ('压缩成型/封装设备/NTCMS4/0-V1' pairs with the WB-BGA/FC-BGA/Chiplet description and '该设备正在厂内测试中') -- note the non-layout rendering genuinely breaks 'NTCMS40-V1' across a line wrap with an unrelated adjacent column's text interposed, so a naive non-layout contiguous-string search falsely suggests the citation is wrong; -layout resolves this and confirms the citation is correct, exactly the trap the protocol warns about. H1 2026 progression to '已发往客户端进行试用' confirmed verbatim on naike_interim_2026h1 p16 (non-layout, stripped). category_id molding_compression correct -- the SAME model's FY2024 R&D-table entry (naike_annual_2024 p30, row 3, confirmed via -layout: stage 样机装配调试试验阶段, budget 1,200/period 492.55/cumulative 829.79) is explicitly labelled 'Compression Molding' in Latin script, consistent with but not cited by the record; this is additional uncited-but-consistent corroboration, not a contradiction, and does not change the decision. Maturity progression lab (FY2025, in-house testing) -> trial (H1 2026, shipped for customer trial) is accurately staged and not inflated to a stronger claim; no memory/HBM application is claimed anywhere, as the notes say.
